findings.title: Queue-level OIDC token without a pinned host lets any enqueuer invoke arbitrary backends as the invoker SA
findings.explanation: http_target.oidc_token attaches an invoker-SA token to every task, and enqueuers need no actAs on that SA. uri_override_host defaults to null, in which case the task's own URL is used, so any holder of roles/cloudtasks.enqueuer can target any URL and call every Cloud Run/Functions service the invoker SA can invoke (confused deputy, an actAs bypass). The module's own grant_enqueuers_act_as flag shows actAs is meant to be opt-in, which this composition silently defeats. No rule covers Cloud Tasks queues.
findings.remediation: Require uri_override_host (which pins host with uri_override_enforce_mode = ALWAYS) unless the caller explicitly trusts enqueuers to act as the invoker SA (grant_enqueuers_act_as = true); enforce via a lifecycle precondition on the queue.

suggested_policies.rationale: A queue-level OIDC token without a uri_override host turns cloudtasks.enqueuer into the ability to invoke anything the token's SA can reach. The condition is two attributes on one resource and applies to any Terraform using google_cloud_tasks_queue, which no loaded policy covers.
suggested_policies.yaml:
id: LOCAL_GCP_001
name: Cloud Tasks queues attaching an OIDC token must pin the target host with uri_override
principle: identity-and-access
severity: MEDIUM
rationale: |
  A queue-level http_target.oidc_token is attached to every task dispatched from the
  queue, and enqueuers need no actAs on the token's service account. Without a
  uri_override host, anyone with cloudtasks.enqueuer can point tasks at any URL and
  invoke every backend that service account can reach (confused deputy).
message: |
  google_cloud_tasks_queue sets http_target.oidc_token but no http_target.uri_override.host.
remediation: |
  Add http_target.uri_override { scheme = "HTTPS", host = "<backend host>", uri_override_enforce_mode = "ALWAYS" },
  or drop the queue-level oidc_token and have enqueuers set per-task tokens (which requires actAs).
resources:
  google_cloud_tasks_queue:
    any:
      - path: http_target.oidc_token
        is_null: true
      - path: http_target.uri_override.host
        not_null: true
